summary: Synchrony Card Funding, LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for the issuance of Class A(2026-2) notes by Synchrony Card Issuance Trust, a routine asset-backed securities transaction. The filing includes agreements with RBC Capital Markets, BofA Securities, and Mizuho, along with related risk retention and terms documents. No special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or strategic moves are present; this is a standard financing disclosure.
